status: skeleton (T010). Vocabulary and pattern subset are [INFERRED] and await user confirmation.

noUnknownFields.meaning: fields not defined by the rule set are rejected (default deny)

type.meaning: value must have this type; integer means whole number, no fractions

enum.meaning: value must be one of the list

refersTo.meaning: value must equal one value found at the referenced path in the same document

atLeastSetting.meaning: integer value >= the named user setting (for example the large-item threshold)

periodOrder.meaning: start month is not later than end month

patternSubset.note: The subset must behave identically in Python and JavaScript; every pattern rule needs conformance cases.

vocabulary.reasonCodes: to be listed per rule when rules are written (T024, T039, T065)
